pages.title: Chapter 2: Find Natural Metals
pages.text: §8[Resource Exploration]$(br2)Metals in Forgeborne Odyssey generate as natural metal blocks in the world. You need to explore the world to find these valuable resources. The three metals generate at different heights and vary in rarity.
§c[Natural Copper] Most Common$(br2)Spawn: Mountains, near rivers$(br)Copper is the most basic forging metal. Prioritize finding it first.
§3[Natural Silver] Quite Rare$(br2)Spawn: High altitude mountains$(br)Silver has excellent forging properties, ideal for precision decorations.
§2[Natural Gold] Very Rare$(br2)Spawn: Riverbanks, beaches$(br)Gold is the most precious metal, perfect for high-end decorations.

pages.title: Quick Find Commands
pages.text: §3Quick find commands:$(br)$(li)/forgeodyssey find nearest_copper$(br)$(li)/forgeodyssey find nearest_silver$(br)$(li)/forgeodyssey find nearest_gold$(br2)Use these commands to quickly locate the nearest natural metal block.

pages.title: Identification Tips
pages.text: Natural metal blocks have distinct appearances:$(br)$(li)Copper - Reddish-brown patches$(br)$(li)Silver - Silvery luster$(br)$(li)Gold - Golden shimmer$(br2)Note: Natural metal blocks are hard and require a stone hammer or better tool to break.
